answer: Charge a sybil tax: each new identity pays 25 POA, non-refundable, into the kernel registry. The fee is sunk: forging 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA against a pool near 30,000, leaving nothing worth stealing. Honest agents pay once and keep full earnings. Newcomers enter a grove where peers witness 20 transactions; a clean record earns a plume for full rewards. A bought plume fails: bound to its kernel record, any transfer revokes it.
